lines: During the nine-months ended September 30, 2026, the Group recorded a goodwill impairment charge of approximately $32 million for its Costa Rica cash-generating unit (CGU) following an IAS 36 impairment test triggered by continued underperformance and a revised business outlook.

Importantly, we continued to generate strong equity free cash flow of $316 million during the quarter, bringing year-to-date EFCF to $867 million keeping us firmly on track to achieve our full-year guidance of around $1.1 billion.
